interpretations: Count inventory records by their film’s rating. Keep ratings whose copy count exceeds the mean copy count across ratings, then return one row with the sum of their copy counts and the unrounded mean of their individual excesses above that mean
queries:
WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copy_count
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
mean_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS mean_copy_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(rc.copy_count) AS total_copy_count,
  AVG(rc.copy_count - mc.mean_copy_count) AS mean_excess
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN mean_count AS mc
WHERE rc.copy_count > mc.mean_copy_count
